purpose: Bounded BLACK worker liveness/queue-consumption canary after XOXNO parcel B remained unreceipted.
objective: Prove whether the existing BLACK worker can consume a valid command-array job and publish a durable receipt.
done_definition: A durable receipt at BLACK/receipts/BLACK-LIVENESS-CANARY-20261007-001.json with exit_code 0 proves current queue consumption and receipt publication for a trivial valid job. Absence after normal poll/transport interval narrows the blocker to BLACK worker/control-plane liveness or receipt publication rather than XOXNO job schema.
